— Towing and roadside breakdown safety","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Towing and roadside breakdown safety

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F01 | anchor: A01
The drawbar or other link between towing and towed vehicles may not be longer than 15 feet from one vehicle to the other [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F02 | anchor: A01
When the tow connection is a chain, rope, or cable, a red flag or other signal at least 12 inches square must be fixed to the connection [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F03 | anchor: A01
A driver must not operate a combination of vehicles when any towed trailer or vehicle whips or swerves dangerously or unreasonably from side to side [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F04 | anchor: A01
Warning devices must be shown when a disabled or stopped vehicle at least 80 inches wide or 30 feet long stays on the road for more than 10 minutes [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F05 | anchor: A01
Warning devices are not required when legally parked in an urban district, lawfully loading passengers, stopped to avoid a conflict, or obeying an officer or traffic control device [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F06 | anchor: A01
In an emergency, first set a flare, lighted fuse, electric lantern, or emergency reflector beside the vehicle on the side facing nearest oncoming traffic [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F07 | anchor: A01
Next place flares, electric lights, or reflectors 100 feet ahead and behind the vehicle, plus one device on the traffic side at least 10 feet behind the vehicle [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F08 | anchor: A01
A vehicle carrying explosives, flammable liquids, or compressed gas must not carry flares or fuses aboard [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F09 | anchor: A80
On a street carrying traffic in one direction, the handbook recommends positioning the rear warning flag two hundred feet behind the stopped vehicle [A80].
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F10 | anchor: A01
Warning devices may be omitted when enough light makes people and vehicles visible from 1,000 feet away [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F11 | anchor: A01
When a breakdown happens within 500 feet before a curve, hilltop, or other blocked view, the device on that side must be moved farther out to warn approaching drivers, staying between 100 feet and 500 feet from the vehicle [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F12 | anchor: A01
Every warning device must sit in the middle of the occupied lane, or on the shoulder as close as possible to the roadway when the vehicle is fully off the road [A01]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F13 | anchor: A02
Keep a burning fuse or flare away from the face and eyes, never fasten a flare or fuse to the vehicle, and keep burning devices away from spilled fuel [A02]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0104]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F14 | anchor: A02
Prevent tire fires by checking tires and brakes for unusual heat, changing soft or flat tires, never driving far on a soft or flat tire or with a dragging brake, never ignoring a hot tire, always releasing the parking brake before moving, and watching for dragging brakes, oil on hot tires, or partly deflated dual tires [A02]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0104]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-F15 | anchor: A02
Fight other fires by aiming each extinguisher burst carefully, keeping the wind at the back, and never using water on gasoline or oil fires because water only spreads them [A02]
Why it matters: Core testable rule for this domain.
